title: Course-map recovery
details: Evia no longer depends on the old unpublished /app course-map files for Bricklayer or Carpentry and Joinery
Bricklayer and both ST0264 pathways now rebuild their learner course map directly from the published Nisi course packs already shipped with Evia
Saved Demo installations now replace the Demo pack with the canonical copy on startup even when the damaged local pack reports the same version number
Fresh no-course startup still stays on the normal Evia setup path instead of falling through to the course-map error
The Bricklayer and Carpentry and Joinery course packs are included in the v225 offline shell
summary: Evia v225 removes the missing legacy course-map dependency that could leave laptops on the 'could not load the course map' screen.
changes: Recovered legacy Bricklayer course-map requests from the published ST0095 Nisi pack
Recovered Site Carpenter and Architectural Joiner course-map requests from the published ST0264 Nisi pack
Added the required published course packs to the offline shell
Created a fresh v225 service-worker cache
